answer.value:
Division of labour leads to specialization.
Specialization means achieving sufficient expertise, training and skill in any particular field.
It has helped people to work in various fields and earn economic profit.
Creates economic strata and class system
It was created by industrialization.
Specialization has become very important in industrial society.
With specialization developing in every field, industries have grown in number.
Trade and commerce have expanded.
